settings.editor: A trailblazer in the development of vivarium technologies, solutions, and services supporting research in 43+ countries for two decades

settings.title: Built on Purpose, Driven by Vision

settings.editor: Founded over 20 years ago, our company began with a simple mission: to make cutting-edge scientific equipment accessible to researchers worldwide. What started as a small distribution operation has grown into a global network spanning 43 countries
Today, we're proud to serve over 500 customers, from university research labs to pharmaceutical companies, providing them with the tools they need to push the boundaries of scientific discovery
We create safe, sterile, and enriched environments for research animals, supporting scientific progress while prioritizing animal and human welfare

Through advanced vivarium services and our Research-Ready disposable IVC System, we streamline operations, reduce resource use, and minimize animal stress.
Everything we do is focused on making research more efficient, sustainable, and respectful of life

At Innovive, you’re not just building a career you’re contributing to a mission that advances scientific discovery while prioritizing sustainability and ethical practices. Our work directly supports the global research community, helping create safer, more efficient environments for both people and animals
